_comment: Improvement ladder. Steps are applied in order and are CUMULATIVE: each step inherits the sources of the previous one and overrides only the slots it names (including the testbench). One step = one hardware change = one build on the board (git ref). 'cpu_mode' selects how the CPU moves the data in that step: 'single' = 10000 single writes into the BRAMs + 2500 single reads from the PL DDR4; 'burst' = the PL fetches A/B and writes C in PS DDR itself, the CPU only flushes/invalidates its cache and reads C from its own memory.

steps.name: Burst data path: PL reads A/B and writes C in PS DDR

cpu_estimates._source: ESTIMATES until measured on the board. single-mode values: midpoints of the analysis report (load 1-2 ms, read-back 0.5-1 ms). Replace t_bram_write_ns and t_plddr_read_ns with the latency probes of Badr's Baseline 1 run (CSV,probe,...). burst-mode values: rough A53 figures (cache maintenance per 64-byte line, cached DDR read per value); to be measured with the rung-4 application.
